scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,api,worker -c cyan,green,yellow "npm run dev --workspace @nexus/web" "npm run start:dev --workspace @nexus/api" "npm run dev --workspace @nexus/worker"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @nexus/api && npm run build --workspace @nexus/worker && npm run build --workspace @nexus/web
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @nexus/api && npm run build --workspace @nexus/worker && node --test
